American English base with Urdu/Arabic presentation readiness; translation-memory ownership remains outside File 25.
RTL logical layout and LTR/RTL screenshot contract.
WCAG-oriented keyboard, focus, zoom, reduced-motion and screen-reader evidence contract.
File 25 owns no covert tracker/raw analytics warehouse; public metrics remain bounded owner-provided aggregates.
Responsive/payload/query source controls exist; real low-end and slow-network measurements are staging evidence.
Source diagnostics/evidence contracts exist; production monitoring remains operational evidence.
Optional provider failures degrade safely without security fail-open.
Two new independent review/fix/retest sets are mandatory after this latest-plan correction.
Versioned migration/dry-run/rollback source exists; real staging backup/restore remains external.
Profile structured data remains truthful and bounded to ProfilePage plus Person/Organization types already supported by the current renderer; no unverified medical or licensing claim is injected.
Canonical/noindex rules exist; sitemap/indexing behavior requires staging evidence.
Canonical safe deep link and optional same-site QR presentation; no open redirect or tracking service.
